title: Repayment Terms by Plan — Home Comfort Financing
content:
Every Home Comfort Financing plan is repaid in monthly payments over a fixed term counted from funding. The repayment terms of each plan are set out below.

## Term and monthly payment

| Plan | Repayment term | Payment structure | Payment factor (monthly payment as a percent of the amount financed) | Smallest monthly payment | First payment due after funding |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 12-Month Same-As-Cash Deferred Interest Plan | 12 months | promotional minimum | 3.0% | $35.00 | 30 calendar days |
| 18-Month 0% APR Equal Payment Plan | 18 months | equal payment | 5.56% | $35.00 | 30 calendar days |
| 36-Month 0% APR Equal Payment Plan | 36 months | equal payment | 2.78% | $35.00 | 30 calendar days |
| 60-Month 5.99% APR Fixed-Rate Plan | 60 months | fixed installment | 1.93% | $35.00 | 45 calendar days |
| 120-Month 7.99% APR Fixed-Rate Plan | 120 months | fixed installment | 1.21% | $35.00 | 45 calendar days |
| 144-Month 9.99% APR Fixed-Rate Plan | 144 months | fixed installment | 1.19% | $35.00 | 45 calendar days |

## Due day, statements and term changes

These terms are the same on all six plans:

| Term | Value on every plan |
|---|---|
| Days of the month the payment can be due | 1 through 28 |
| Due-day changes allowed in any 12 months | 1 |
| Term extension available on request | 0 months (no extension) |
| Statement period | calendar month; the statement closes on the last day of the month |
| Order in which a payment is applied | returned-payment fees, then late fees, then interest, then principal |
| Penalty for paying early | none |

## Points of reading

- The payment factor is a percentage of the amount financed, and the smallest monthly payment on every plan is $35.00.
- The first payment on a promotional plan (12-Month, 18-Month, 36-Month) falls 30 calendar days after funding; on a fixed-rate plan (60-Month, 120-Month, 144-Month) it falls 45 calendar days after funding.
- A due day may only be one of the days 1 through 28 of the month, on every plan.
- No plan carries a prepayment penalty, and no plan offers a term extension.
